english.note: Use this colloquial phrasing when explicitly saying that too many tickets were sold, rather than merely guaranteed.

examples.english: They managed to overbook by selling too many tickets, so some people had no seats on the day.
examples.traditional: 佢哋賣多咗飛，入場嗰日有人冇位坐。
